# Lab 3.4: Tour the Google Cloud Console

## What We Are Going to Do
Find your way around the console: project picker, navigation menu, IAM, APIs, Cloud Shell, and the security pages used in this course.

## Steps

1. **Pick the right scope.** Click the project picker. Switch between the **organization** and your **lab project**. Most pages change depending on the scope you select.

2. **Pin the products you will use.** Open the **Navigation menu** (top left). Hover over **IAM & Admin**, **VPC network**, **Security** and **Logging** and click the pin icon for each.

3. **Find APIs.** Go to **APIs & Services → Library**. Search `Cloud Resource Manager API` and check that it is enabled. Many labs start by enabling an API.

4. **Use the search bar.** Type `Security Command Center` in the top search bar and open it. Searching is the fastest way to find any page.

5. **Check notifications and activity.** Click the bell icon to see recent operations. Then open **Activity** on the project dashboard to see who changed what.

6. **Open Cloud Shell.** Click the **Activate Cloud Shell** icon at the top right. A terminal opens at the bottom of the page.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Scope | Organization, folder or project, chosen in the picker |
| APIs | Most services need their API enabled first |
| Search bar | Fastest way to reach any page |
| Cloud Shell | Free terminal with gcloud ready to use |
